##### So much to see during your visit ...

[![Dan-yr-Ogof](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/press-enq-dyo6-347x231.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/dan-yr-ogof.html)

[![Dan-yr-Ogof](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/dyo-1-cropped-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/dan-yr-ogof.html)

##### **DAN-YR-OGOF**

Awe-inspiring  passageways!

##### **DINOSAUR PARK**

One of the LARGEST in the world!

[![Cathedral Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/cathedral-cave-gallery-pics-2-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/cathedral-cave.html)

[![Cathedral Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/cathedral-cave-slider-pics7-1-1000x500.jpeg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/cathedral-cave.html)

##### **CATHEDRAL CAVE**

Some of Mother Nature’s finest work!

[![The Playgrounds](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/the-playground-gallery-pics-2-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/playground.html)

[![The Playgrounds](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/the-playground-gallery-pics-1-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/playground.html)

##### **PLAYGROUNDS**

Fun indoors and out, whatever the weather!

[![Bone Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/bone-cave-400x266.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/bone-cave.html)

[![Bone Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/bone-cave-gallery-pics-1-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/bone-cave.html)

##### **BONE CAVE**

Why were 42 human skeletons buried here?

[![Shire Horse Centre](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/shire-horse-800px-510x435.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/shire-horse.html)

[![Shire Horse Centre](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/shire-horse-2-800px-140x119.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/shire-horse.html)

##### **SHIRE HORSE CENTRE**

Say hello to these gentle giants…

[![The Farm](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/the-farm-pig-800px-510x435.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/farm.html)

[![The Farm](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/the-farm-bird-800px-510x435.jpeg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/farm.html)

##### **THE FARM**

Meet our friendly farm animals!

[![Iron Age Village](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/iron-age-village-1-800px-510x435.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/iron-age-farm.html)

[![Iron Age Village](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/2-140x70.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/iron-age-farm.html)

##### **IRON AGE VILLAGE**

Bringing the past to life, from 700 BC...

[![Stone Circles](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/stone-circles-gallery-pics-2-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/stone-circles.html)

[![Stone Circles](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/stone-circles-gallery-pics-4-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/stone-circles.html)

##### **STONE CIRCLES**

How? Why? Will we ever know..?

[![The Fossil House](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/fossil-house-gallery-pics-2-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/fossil-house.html)

[![The Fossil House](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/fossil-house-gallery-pics-3-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/fossil-house.html)

##### **FOSSIL HOUSE**

What fossils will you discover?

[![Panning for Gold](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/panning-for-gold-gallery-pics-4-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/panning-for-gold.html)

[![Panning for Gold](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/3-gold-nuggets-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/panning-for-gold.html)

##### **PANNING FOR GOLD**

Will you find a nugget?

[![The Museum](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/museum-gallery-pics-5-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/museum.html)

[![The Museum](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/assets/images/museum-gallery-pics-1-750x500.jpg)](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/museum.html)

##### **THE MUSEUM**

Explore, discover, and learn.

Dan-yr-Ogof, the National Showcaves Centre for Wales, sits hidden in a National Nature Reserve in the Upper Swansea Valley, in the Brecon Beacons. Its three showcaves, shaped over 315 million years, allow you to step back in time to explore twisting, winding passageways, waterfalls and caverns, and discover thousands of unique stalactites, all at your own pace.

[Dan-yr-Ogof](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/dan-yr-ogof.html) was discovered by the Morgan brothers in 1912, [Cathedral Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/cathedral-cave.html) holds the breathtaking cavern known as the Dome of St Paul's, and [Bone Cave](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/bone-cave.html) is where 42 Bronze Age skeletons were discovered.

Above ground find an [Iron Age village](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/iron-age-farm.html), [stone circles](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/stone-circles.html), and a [museum](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/museum.html), and for younger visitors, a [dinosaur park](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/dinosaur-park.html), [Shire horses](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/shire-horse.html), a [farm](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/farm.html), and indoor and outdoor [play areas](https://www.showcaves.co.uk/playground.html). All on one ticket!
